name: Three Standing Buddhist Devotees, Each Holding a Lotus Bud
summary: Three standing Buddhist devotees facing proper left, holding lotus buds on long stalks between clasped hands. Low sandstone relief from cave 3 (south wall) at Tianlongshan, Shanxi province.
